_comment: Optional whitelist controlling which broker-config-file properties may override the running Kafka config. Ordered, first-match-wins ('first pass, first pick'). Patterns are wildcard (* = any sequence, ? = single char) and match Confluent.Kafka property names case-insensitively. A property matching no rule is denied. If this whole file is absent, every property in the broker config files is applied.

consume._comment: Deny one specific property even though the next rule would allow it (first-match-wins).
